_comment: semantic-release ONLY computes the version, updates CHANGELOG + package.json, and pushes the git tag. The existing release.yml workflow (triggered by the pushed v*.*.* tag) does ALL publishing: npm, 4 binaries, multi-arch container -> ghcr.io, helm OCI, GitHub Release, cosign, SLSA. No @semantic-release/npm publish and no @semantic-release/github here, by design — release.yml owns those.

plugins._comment: Runs AFTER @semantic-release/npm bumps package.json, so generate-schema.ts reads the new version and rewrites schema/mock.json ($id pinned to the minor) + schema/VERSION. The regenerated files are committed via @semantic-release/git below.

No [skip ci] — it would suppress release.yml on the pushed tag too (GitHub skips ALL workflows for a [skip ci] commit, including tag pushes). The self-re-trigger loop is prevented by semantic-release.yml's job-level guard that skips chore(release): commits.
